_comment: Regression corpus for the review judges. Balanced on purpose - see docs/LLM-AS-JUDGE.md. Expected verdicts are regenerated by the deterministic Part A oracle, never hand-typed.

degenerate_baseline.note: If a judge scores near the degenerate baseline, the eval is measuring the base rate rather than the judge.

judge_models._rule: Changing any value here requires re-running the corpus in the same change.

cases.why: All sections, metrics with baseline + mechanism, Gherkin throughout.
Gate 2: target stated, no baseline, no measurement mechanism.
Gate 3: unresolved [TBD] survives into a graduation candidate.
Gate 4: acceptance criteria in prose, not Given/When/Then.
Open question is named, owned and dated. Guards a judge that treats any open question as failure.
Short is not incomplete. Guards against a judge that rewards length.
One option presented. A rubber-stamp request, not a decision document.
Red team: reach figure has no source. The most common laundered input.
Assumption named, falsifier stated, build-vs-buy considered.
Two options, one of which is do-nothing with a real cost. Guards a judge that demands three.
Hard to read, materially complete. Guards against style-over-substance judging.
